zh.demo_banner: 这是演示数据：项目、运行、花费和对话都是编的，放在系统临时目录里。会启动智能体的按钮只显示命令、不运行；你自己的 hub 和各工具的设置都没动。
zh.act_demo: 演示数据：这条命令会启动智能体，所以演示里只显示、不运行。
zh.sw_unknown: 这个项目还看不出谁在主导：先在这里用 Claude Code 或 Codex 派一次活。
zh.sw_lead: 把这个项目交给另一个主导：ccx 把交接（做完了什么、定了什么、下一步）写进项目；当前主导的对话文件在的话就从它整理（只用代码，不调模型）。另一个工具在这里开新对话时会读到它。
zh.sw_paste: 在 {d} 打开 {w} 时，把下面这一行发给它（它启动时也会自动显示一次这份交接）：
zh.sw_paste_read: 在 {d} 打开 {w} 时，把下面这一行发给它（它启动时不会自动显示交接，这一行让它去读那份文件）：
zh.sw_blank: 这份交接是空白模板：没找到当前主导在这个文件夹的对话文件。把“做完了什么、定了什么、下一步”填进 {f}，再把下面这一行发出去。
zh.sw_blank_pre: 没找到当前主导在这个文件夹的对话文件，所以这会写一份空白交接模板，交出去之前要你自己填好。
zh.j_no_check: 这次没给验收命令（--check），ccx 没跑任何检查
zh.j_unchanged: 检查是在没改过的代码上跑的，不能说明改动是对的
zh.j_mismatch: 它报的改动文件和实际改动对不上
zh.j_check_files: 注意：快照是在 ccx 跑完验收命令之后记的，验收命令写出的文件（没被 .gitignore 忽略的）也会出现在“实际改了”里
zh.j_match: 它报的文件和实际改动一致
zh.j_changed: 实际改动的文件（{n} 个，来自 ccx 自己的快照）
zh.j_chain: 从这条链的第一轮（{r}）开始算
zh.j_untracked_before: {n} 个运行前就有、未纳入 git 的文件没算进来（看不出是否被改）
zh.j_truncated: diff 太长，只显示了前一部分（已截断）
zh.j_loading: 正在读 ccx 的快照…
zh.j_snap: 快照页面不含实际 diff，请在 ccx ui 里看
zh.j_running: 还在运行，结束后才有实际改动
zh.j_read_only: 只读运行，没有改动快照
zh.j_no_snapshot: 这次运行没有改动快照（旧版本记录），只能显示它自己报的文件
zh.j_no_end: 没有记下运行结束时的代码树，算不出实际改动
zh.j_repo_gone: 快照所在的仓库已不在（或 git 读不到），算不出实际改动
zh.j_untracked_names: 新建的未跟踪文件只记了文件名，内容没进快照；其中也可能有 ccx 的验收命令自己写出的文件
zh.j_untracked_many: 运行前未跟踪的文件太多，diff 里可能混有它们
zh.q_none: 还没有额度读数（派过活后才有）
zh.q_early: 记录不到 6 小时，还不能推算
zh.q_proj: 按现在的速度，到重置时 {p}%
zh.empty: 现在没有在做的事。派过活之后，这里会显示谁在做什么。
zh.ov_nothing: 一切正常，没有要你做的事
zh.ov_quota_bad: {a} 的额度按现在的速度会在重置前用到 {p}%，新活少派给它
zh.sug_lead: ccx 从会话里挑出来的偏好、决定和坑。同意就写进共享记忆（两边的新会话和子智能体都能用上），拒绝就丢掉。
zh.sug_more: 还有 {n} 条，处理完上面的会接着显示；全部：`ccx mem suggestions --all`
zh.leads_now: 现在的组长（最近 15 分钟有动静的对话）
zh.week_spent: 最近 7 天子智能体花了约 {u}（{n} 次运行，按 API 价格折算；订阅用户实际付的是额度）。
zh.week_cash: 其中真钱 {u}（按 token 付费的服务）。
zh.saved_see_report: 确认过的结果够多了，省了多少见 ccx report。
zh.saved_unknown: 省了多少：还不知道（需要约 {need} 次确认，现在 {n} 次）。
zh.snap_banner: 这是 {at} 生成的快照，不会自动更新。
zh.offline_banner: 连不上 ccx ui 了（可能已经退出）。在终端里重新运行 ccx ui。
zh.ctl_running: 在跑。停下后会话保留，之后可以续跑。
zh.act_will: 确认后在这台电脑上运行：
zh.act_spends: 会启动子智能体，花额度或钱；在后台跑，几秒后这里会更新。
zh.act_records: 只记一笔或停下，不启动模型、不花钱。
zh.act_usd: 新的上限（美元，按 API 价格折算）
zh.act_started: 已在后台开始：{c}。几秒后图上会出现这次运行。
zh.month_wait: 这个月的数字正在算（读一遍账本，几秒）…
zh.month_spent: 这个月（{d} 起）子智能体花了约 {u}，{n} 次运行（按 API 价格折算；订阅用户实际付的是额度）。
zh.month_saving: 相对估算：约省了 {u}{ci}（{n} 次做成的运行）
zh.month_extra: 相对估算：反而多花了约 {u}{ci}（{n} 次做成的运行）
zh.month_saving_none: 省了多少：还算不出（要有做成的、由 Claude 或 Codex 组长派出的运行）。
zh.month_model: 这是估算，不是账单：同样的活由组长的模型自己做大概要花多少，减去子智能体实际花的和组长写简报、看结果的开销；没做成的不算省。和 ccx report 同一算法；`ccx trial` 实测够了就换成实测值。
zh.month_measured: 来自 ccx trial 的实测：每个任务实测省下的，乘以这个月做成的委派运行数。
zh.others_lead: 最近没有派出去的活（ccx projects 的目录）。说到其中一个时，ccx where 能找到它。
zh.rules_lead: 这个项目的规则文件里讲审批、授权或冻结的句子，ccx 只摘出来；能不能做由组长判断。
zh.in_split: 拆成 {n} 块：{d} 完成 · {r} 在做 · {k} 等你
zh.needs_more: 还有 {n} 件 → 只看要我处理的
zh.boss_unknown: 你直接派的（没有组长对话）
zh.helper: 组长自带的子智能体 ×{n}（最近 15 分钟）
zh.legend: 每一列是一个干活的 · 红框 = 要你拍板 · 橙框 = 要你 review · 虚线 = 自带子智能体 · 新加的智能体会自动多一列
zh.d_native: {w} 自己开的子智能体（不经过 ccx 选模型；花费算在这一块里，审查也和这一块一起做）：
zh.pick: 点图上任何一块看它的详情；红框、橙框的是要你处理的，这里会显示原因、依据和按钮；会改东西的按钮先给你看要运行的命令，再点一次才运行。
zh.why_bad: 哪里不对？（会记进这次的结果，选模型能学到）
zh.will_run: 要运行的命令（复制到终端，或交给组长运行）：
zh.no_token: 这个网址缺少口令。请用 ccx ui 在终端里打印的完整网址打开（# 后面那一段就是口令）。
zh.a_needs_write: 只读任务说要改文件才能做完
zh.a_review_failed: 独立审查改过一轮，还是不过
zh.a_check_failed: 说做完了，但验收命令没过
zh.a_check_broken: 验收命令本身坏了，什么也没测到
zh.a_no_changes: 说做完了，但什么都没改
zh.a_review: 做完了，等你确认对不对
zh.w_stale: {m} 分钟没有写入任何东西，可能卡住了。可以先看它最后做到哪。
zh.w_needs_write: 这块按只读派出去，所以它没动文件，只写下了想改什么、为什么。要不要让它改，由你决定。
zh.w_review_failed: 另一家的模型（{by}）审查后仍认为有问题。该由主智能体对着 diff 逐条核对 [must]，属实的自己修、不属实的放下；再改一轮要多花一次运行，只在你要求时才做。
zh.w_check_failed: ccx 重新运行了验收命令 {cmd}，退出码 {exit}。
zh.w_check_broken: 验收命令 {cmd} 没测到任何东西（{why}）。这不说明改动对错，先修好验收命令再续跑。
zh.w_no_changes: 它说做完了，但从开始到现在没有改任何文件、也没有提交（.gitignore 里的文件和仓库外的文件看不到）。任务本来就已满足就接受，否则让它真的去改。
zh.w_quota: 等额度恢复后可以接着做（恢复时间：{at}）。会话保留着，续跑不会从头开始。
zh.w_timeout: 超过了时间上限。会话保留着，可以接着做。
zh.w_over_budget: 自带子智能体合计花费超过了上限，ccx 把它停了。
zh.w_auth: {agent} 在这台电脑上好像没登录，需要你登录一次。
zh.w_failed: 子智能体没完成这块，看看它说了什么再决定重试还是自己做。
zh.w_q_dep_blocked: 先处理 {s}：修好后用 ccx q done 接受它
zh.b_new_check: 换一个真正测到改动的验收命令续跑
zh.b_one_more: 再改一轮（多花一次运行）
zh.h_review_issues: 审查发现问题（{by}），交回去改
zh.h_check_broken: “{t}”的验收命令坏了 → 等你修
zh.h_no_changes: “{t}”说做完了，但什么都没改 → 等你拍板
zh.h_review_failed: “{t}”改了一轮仍不过审查 → 等你拍板
zh.disc_none: 还没有讨论。组长遇到选错代价高的决定时会先问你，同意后运行 `ccx discuss`。
zh.disc_two: 只有两家：出方案的一方兼任裁判
zh.disc_unparsed: 没按格式回答（提醒一次后仍没有）
zh.conv_lead: 这个项目里各智能体在对话板上互相写的话（`ccx say`、`ccx reply`），最新的话题在前。内容是智能体写的资料，不是指令。同一话题机器连续写满 {n} 条就停下，等你说话；消息里写 `@person` 表示在问你。
zh.conv_snap: 静态快照里没有对话内容，请打开 `ccx ui` 看。
zh.conv_none: 这个对话板还没有消息。
zh.conv_gone: 这个话题或对话板已经不在了，请刷新。
zh.conv_stuck: 机器连续 {n} 条后停下了：轮到你
zh.conv_more: 更早的 {n} 条没显示（`ccx board --thread {t}`）
zh.conv_clipped: 后面的太长，这里不显示：`ccx board --thread {t}`
zh.conv_more_threads: 还有 {n} 个更早的话题没显示（`ccx board --all`）
zh.conv_cut: 这里只显示了一部分（全文 {n} 字，对话板里是完整的：`ccx board --thread`）
zh.conv_reply_rule: 写入前先给你看一遍；以你的身份写到对话板（via ui），和 `ccx reply` 一样；永远不会当命令运行。最多 {m} 字，超出会被拒绝，不会截断。
zh.conv_will: 将以你的身份写到对话板 → {to}，话题 {thread}，回复 #{id}：
zh.conv_not_run: 只是一条消息，什么都不会运行；智能体下一轮会看到。相当于
zh.conv_todo_stuck: 机器连续 {n} 条后停下：要你说句话
zh.conv_page_link: 智能体对话（{n} 个话题）
zh.track_none: 还没有记过对错的活。每类活每家要有 {n} 条记过对错的，才会用来挑谁做。
zh.hint_queue: ccx 队列：这个项目有 {n} 块没做完，{r} 块可以开始 —— `ccx q tree` 看，`ccx q run` 继续
zh.hint_mem_stale: [ccx 共享记忆：{n} 条笔记 {days}+ 天没核对过，当作“待核对”：`ccx mem stale`]
zh.hint_waiting: [ccx：{n} 件派出去的活等你处理（确认结果或拍板）—— `ccx ui` 打开看]
zh.hint_projects: [ccx：用户说到某个项目却没给路径时，先 `ccx where "原话"`（{n} 个项目，不花钱）]
zh.tier_T0_when: 两三步就能完成、只改一两处、或说明任务比做任务还长。派出去的开销（写简报+对方读仓库）比直接做更贵。
zh.tier_T1_when: 改名、格式化、补注释/类型、按明确规则批量替换、样板代码、总结日志、查找定位。
zh.tier_T2_when: 单个功能、复现清楚的 bug、补测试、单模块小重构、写脚本。
zh.tier_T3_when: 跨多个文件/模块、原因不明的 bug、性能问题、需要先读懂较大代码库再改、方案设计。
zh.tier_T4_when: 架构决策、安全审查、并发/正确性证明、新算法、出错代价很高的改动。
zh.hint_context: [ccx] 这个对话每一轮都要重读约 {k}k token（约 ${usd} 一轮，已 {turns} 轮）。往后更省的做法：大段阅读（很多文件、日志、调研）交给子智能体，只拿回结论；如果接下来是新的一件事，换一个新对话接着做：先问一下用户，再运行 `ccx fresh`（它从这个对话的文件写好交接；在这个文件夹里开的新对话会从它开始）。

en.demo_banner: Demo data: made-up projects, runs, costs and conversations in the system's temporary folder. Buttons that would start an agent only show their command; your own hub and your tools' settings are untouched.
en.act_demo: Demo data: this command would start an agent, so the demo only shows it.
en.sw_unknown: No lead is known for this project yet: send one task from Claude Code or Codex here first.
en.sw_lead: Hand this project to another lead: ccx writes the handoff (what's done, decisions, next) into the project, from the current lead's conversation file when it is there (by code, no model). The other tool reads it when a conversation starts here.
en.sw_paste: When you open {w} in {d}, give it this line (its start also shows the handoff once):
en.sw_paste_read: When you open {w} in {d}, give it this line (it does not show the handoff when it starts; this line tells it to read the file):
en.sw_blank: This handoff is a blank template: no conversation file of the current lead was found for this folder. Fill in what is done, the decisions and what comes next in {f} before giving the line below.
en.sw_blank_pre: No conversation file of the current lead was found for this folder, so this writes a blank handoff template that you fill in before handing over.
en.j_no_verif: It did not say how it verified
en.j_no_check: No acceptance check (--check) was given: ccx ran nothing
en.j_unchanged: The check ran on an unchanged tree: it says nothing about the change
en.j_mismatch: The files it reported and the files actually changed differ
en.j_check_files: Note: the snapshot is taken after ccx's check ran, so files the check wrote (unless .gitignore'd) also show as changed
en.j_match: The files it reported match the actual change
en.j_changed: Files actually changed ({n}, from ccx's own snapshots)
en.j_chain: Counted from the chain's first round ({r})
en.j_untracked_before: {n} file(s) untracked before the run left out (can't tell if they changed)
en.j_truncated: The diff is long: only its start is shown (truncated)
en.j_failed: Could not read the actual change: {e}
en.j_snap: A snapshot page has no actual diff: open it in ccx ui
en.j_running: Still running: the actual change comes when it ends
en.j_read_only: A read-only run: no change snapshot
en.j_no_snapshot: This run has no change snapshot (an older record): only the files it reported are shown
en.j_no_end: The tree at the run's end was not recorded: the actual change can't be computed
en.j_repo_gone: The snapshot's repository is gone (or git can't read it): the actual change can't be computed
en.j_untracked_names: New untracked files are known by name only: their content is not in the snapshot; some may have been written by ccx's own check
en.j_untracked_many: Too many files were untracked before the run: the diff may include them
en.run_stale: no sign of life for a while
en.q_none: No quota readings yet (they come with delegated runs)
en.q_early: less than 6 h of readings: too early to project
en.empty: Nothing is being worked on right now. Once work is delegated, this shows who does what.
en.ov_quota_bad: at this pace {a}'s quota reaches {p}% before it resets, so send it less
en.sug_lead: Preferences, decisions and pitfalls ccx picked from a session. Yes writes it to shared memory (new sessions on both sides and sub-agents can use it); no drops it.
en.sug_failed: Didn't work; reload and try again
en.sug_more: {n} more come up as you answer these; all of them: `ccx mem suggestions --all`
en.leads_now: Leads now (conversations active in the last 15 minutes)
en.week_spent: Sub-agents cost about {u} in the last 7 days ({n} runs, at API prices; on a subscription you pay in quota).
en.week_cash: Of that, {u} is real money (pay-per-token services).
en.saved_see_report: Enough verdicts to tell: see ccx report for how much was saved.
en.saved_unknown: Saved so far: not known yet (needs about {need} verdicts, there are {n}).
en.snap_banner: A snapshot made at {at}; it does not update.
en.offline_banner: Can't reach ccx ui (it may have exited). Run ccx ui again in a terminal.
en.ctl_running: Running. Stopping keeps its session: it can be continued later.
en.act_will: after you confirm, this runs on this machine:
en.act_spends: Starts a sub-agent, which spends quota or money; it runs in the background and shows up here in a few seconds.
en.act_records: Only records something or stops a run: no model is started, nothing is spent.
en.act_usd: the new cap (USD at API prices)
en.act_started: Started in the background: {c}. The run shows up on the chart in a few seconds.
en.month_wait: This month's numbers are being read (one pass over the ledger, a few seconds)…
en.month_spent: This month (since {d}) sub-agents spent about {u} over {n} runs (at API prices; on a subscription you pay in quota).
en.month_saving: Relative estimate: about {u} saved{ci} ({n} runs that worked)
en.month_extra: Relative estimate: about {u} more spent{ci} ({n} runs that worked)
en.month_saving_none: Saved: not known yet (it needs runs that worked, sent by a Claude or Codex lead).
en.month_model: An estimate, not a bill: what the lead's own model would have spent on the same work, minus what the sub-agent spent and the lead's brief-and-review overhead; a run that failed saved nothing. Same rule as ccx report; once `ccx trial` has measured enough, the measured value replaces it.
en.month_measured: Measured by ccx trial: the saving per task it measured, times this month's delegated runs that worked.
en.others_lead: Nothing delegated there lately (the ccx projects catalog). ccx where finds one when it is mentioned.
en.rules_lead: Lines of this project's rule files about approval, authorization or a freeze, quoted by ccx; whether a task is allowed is the lead's call.
en.in_split: split into {n}: {d} done · {r} running · {k} for you
en.boss_unknown: Sent by you directly (no lead conversation)
en.legend: Each column is one worker · red frame = your call · amber frame = please review · dashed = own sub-agents · a newly added agent gets its own column
en.d_native: Sub-agents {w} started itself (not routed by ccx; their cost is part of this piece, and they are reviewed with it):
en.pick: Click any block for its details; red and amber ones need you, and this panel shows why, the evidence and buttons; a button that changes something shows its command first and runs only on a second click.
en.why_bad: What's wrong? (recorded with the result, so model choice learns)
en.will_run: the command to run (copy it to a terminal or hand it to the lead):
en.no_token: This address has no token. Open the full address ccx ui printed in the terminal (the part after # is the token).
en.a_stale: No sign of life for a while
en.a_needs_write: A read-only piece says files must change
en.a_review_failed: Still fails review after one round of fixes
en.a_check_failed: Says it's done, but the check fails
en.a_check_broken: The check itself is broken: it tested nothing
en.a_no_changes: Says it's done, but changed nothing
en.a_q_needs_write: A read-only piece says files must change
en.a_q_dep_blocked: Waits on a piece that did not finish
en.w_stale: Nothing written for {m} minutes; it may be stuck. See how far it got first.
en.w_needs_write: It was sent out read-only, so it changed nothing and wrote down what it would change and why. Whether it may edit is your call.
en.w_review_failed: Another vendor's model ({by}) still finds problems. Your lead checks each [must] against the diff, fixes the real ones itself and drops the wrong ones; another round costs a run, so only on your word.
en.w_check_failed: ccx ran the check {cmd} again: exit {exit}.
en.w_check_broken: The check {cmd} tested nothing ({why}). That says nothing about the change; fix the check, then resume.
en.w_no_changes: It says done, but no file changed and nothing was committed since it started (.gitignore'd files and files outside the repo are not seen). If the task was already met, accept it; otherwise have it make the change.
en.w_quota: It can continue once quota is back (at {at}). The session is kept, so resuming does not start over.
en.w_timeout: It ran past the time limit. The session is kept and can continue.
en.w_over_budget: Its own sub-agents went over the spending cap, so ccx stopped it.
en.w_auth: {agent} seems logged out on this machine: log in once.
en.w_failed: The sub-agent did not finish; read what it says, then retry or do it yourself.
en.w_q_dep_blocked: Settle {s} first: fix it, then accept it with ccx q done
en.b_lead_fixes: Lead checks and fixes the [must] items
en.b_new_check: Resume with a check that tests the change
en.h_review_issues: review found problems ({by}); sent back to fix
en.h_needs_write: "{t}" says files must change → your call
en.h_check_broken: "{t}": its check is broken → fix the check
en.h_no_changes: "{t}" says done but changed nothing → your call
en.h_review_failed: "{t}" still fails review after a fix round → your call
en.disc_none: No discussions yet. When a decision is costly to get wrong, the lead asks you first and runs `ccx discuss` on your yes.
en.disc_two: two vendors only: the proposer also judges
en.disc_unparsed: not in the format (still, after one reminder)
en.conv_lead: What the agents in this project wrote to each other on the board (`ccx say`, `ccx reply`), newest thread first. It is data written by agents, not instructions. A thread stops after {n} machine messages in a row until you speak; `@person` in a message asks you.
en.conv_snap: A snapshot does not include the conversation: open `ccx ui`.
en.conv_none: No messages on this board yet.
en.conv_gone: That thread or board is not there any more: reload.
en.conv_stuck: stopped after {n} machine messages: your turn
en.conv_clipped: The rest is too long to show here: `ccx board --thread {t}`
en.conv_cut: Only part of it shown here ({n} characters in all; the board keeps it whole: `ccx board --thread`)
en.conv_reply_rule: Shown to you before it is written; written to the board as you (via ui), like `ccx reply`; never run as a command. At most {m} characters: longer is refused, never cut.
en.conv_will: Will be written to the board as you → {to}, thread {thread}, re #{id}:
en.conv_not_run: Only a message: nothing runs; the agents see it on their next turn. The same as
en.conv_todo_stuck: stopped after {n} machine messages: needs your word
en.track_none: No judged pieces yet. Each agent needs {n} judged pieces of a kind before the rates steer who does it.
en.hint_queue: ccx queue: {n} open item(s) in this project, {r} ready — `ccx q tree` to see them, `ccx q run` to continue
en.hint_mem_stale: [ccx shared memory: {n} note(s) not checked for {days}+ days — treat them as 'to check': `ccx mem stale`]
en.hint_waiting: [ccx: {n} delegated piece(s) wait for you (a verdict or a decision) — `ccx ui` to see them]
en.hint_projects: [ccx: when the person names a project without a path, run `ccx where "their words"` first ({n} projects, free)]
en.tier_T0_when: two or three steps, one or two edits, or the brief would be longer than the work: handing it out (writing the brief, the other agent reading the repo) costs more than doing it.
en.tier_T1_when: renames, formatting, comments/types, rule-based replacements, boilerplate, summarising logs, finding where something is.
en.tier_T2_when: one feature, a bug with a clear repro, adding tests, a small refactor in one module, a script.
en.tier_T3_when: across several files/modules, a bug with an unclear cause, performance, a larger codebase to understand first, design.
en.tier_T4_when: architecture decisions, security review, concurrency/correctness proofs, new algorithms, changes where a mistake costs a lot.
en.hint_context: [ccx] This conversation re-reads about {k}k tokens every turn (≈ ${usd} a turn, {turns} turns so far). Cheaper from here: send big reads (many files, logs, research) to a sub-agent and take back only its conclusion; and if what comes next is a new piece of work, hand over to a fresh conversation: ask the person, then run `ccx fresh` (it writes the handoff from this conversation's file; a new conversation in this folder starts with it).
